themes.name: Pipeline Outage Technical Remediation
themes.definition: Calls addressing the architectural investigation, failover engineering, and technical root-cause remediation of streaming ingestion and pipeline outages.
themes.boundary_note: Focuses on underlying platform infrastructure outages and remediation rather than account churn, billing reconciliations, or ongoing SIEM egress connector tuning.

themes.name: Commercial Renewals and Retention
themes.definition: Commercial discussions covering contract renewals, account expansions, multi-year commitments, SLA negotiations, and churn prevention following service disruptions.
themes.boundary_note: Focuses on commercial contract terms and account retention rather than transactional invoice disputes or day-to-day competitive battlecard reviews.

themes.name: Compliance Product Adoption and Expansion
themes.definition: Calls involving product previews, rollout readiness, feature demonstrations, roadmap requests, and post-launch template formatting for multi-framework compliance reporting.
themes.boundary_note: Covers feature adoption, custom framework requests, and post-launch template reporting issues in Comply rather than billing overages or commercial contract negotiations.
themes.note: Broadened slightly to incorporate post-launch report formatting and template defects identified in the pilot.

themes.name: Identity Authentication and Directory Provisioning
themes.definition: Calls concerning directory synchronization queues, SAML SSO regressions, session timeouts, and SCIM/IAM policy provisioning.
themes.boundary_note: Distinguished from initial module deployment scoping by focusing on specific directory sync failures, SSO configurations, and IAM policy defects.

themes.name: Backup Performance and Scalability
themes.definition: Calls addressing degraded backup throughput, snapshot deduplication bottlenecks, connector permission failures, and restore limitations.
themes.boundary_note: Focuses specifically on Aegis Protect backup and restore performance rather than initial onboarding architecture or ingestion pipeline downtime.

themes.name: Customer Implementation and Architecture Scoping
themes.definition: Structured onboarding, technical kickoff, and environment scoping sessions guiding new customers through initial policy and module deployment.
themes.boundary_note: Focuses on new customer platform onboarding and design scoping before operational steady-state or post-launch defect troubleshooting.

themes.name: Billing and Usage Ingestion Disputes
themes.definition: Calls where customers question, review, or dispute surprise invoice overages stemming from ingestion replays, report runs, retention limits, or seat count discrepancies.
themes.boundary_note: Addresses transactional charge reconciliations and disputed invoice line items rather than strategic contract renewals or retention negotiations.
themes.note: Added as a new theme to capture recurring customer invoice and overage disputes (4 calls in Other, aligning with r2.c9).

themes.name: Competitive Strategy and Enablement
themes.definition: Internal calls evaluating competitor intelligence, sales battlecards, displacement tactics, and win-loss deal dynamics against rivals.
themes.boundary_note: Focuses on internal competitive analysis and positioning rather than direct customer renewal or account retention meetings.
themes.note: Added as a new theme to capture recurring internal competitive reviews and positioning syncs (4 calls in Other, aligning with r1.c7).

product_areas.name: Aegis Detect
product_areas.note: Core threat detection, streaming event ingestion, and alert monitoring module.

product_areas.name: Aegis Comply
product_areas.note: Automated multi-framework compliance reporting and evidence mapping module.

product_areas.name: Aegis Protect
product_areas.note: Cloud snapshot backup, deduplication, and disaster recovery orchestration module.

product_areas.name: Aegis Identity
product_areas.note: Directory synchronization, SAML SSO, and cloud IAM governance module.

dropped_candidates.reason: Merged out due to negligible independent call volume and folded into general support and product feedback triage.
Ingestion pipeline latency bottlenecks are subsumed into Pipeline Outage Technical Remediation or general connector troubleshooting.
Alert threshold and rule tuning generated minimal call volume and overlaps with customer support and onboarding workflows.
SIEM connector forwarding latencies and buffer timeouts represent specific technical bugs handled under support triage.
Internal corporate SOC 2 readiness meetings represent periodic internal compliance overhead without broader cross-call customer applicability.

other_policy: Calls are routed to Other / new theme if they are routine internal operational syncs (such as sprint planning, retrospectives, or general all-hands) or isolated one-off inquiries not covered by the 8 themes.
rationale: We resolved the high Other rate (19%) by introducing two actionable themes supported by clusters of calls in the Other dataset: Billing and Usage Ingestion Disputes and Competitive Strategy and Enablement. To remain within the 8-theme ceiling, we retired the low-volume Detection Alert Tuning theme and folded Comply defect reports into Comply Feature Adoption. Routine sprint meetings and internal SOC 2 prep are explicitly assigned to Other, reducing the unclassified volume safely below the 10% threshold.
